svg.title: Recognition
svg.desc: Rajasthan Rank 1, VBYLD 2026 (2026): National finalist, top 0.0005% of 50.49 lakh. Presented Krishyak to the Union Agriculture Minister. Global Finalist Nominee (2025): NASA Space Apps Challenge, exoplanet detection. 1st place, IETE Engineers' Day (2026): Student project competition, with Krishyak. #11 Product of the Day (2026): LLMSlim on its Product Hunt launch. Polaris Fellowship, final round (2026): Top 100 applicants from across India. Smart India Hackathon 2026 (2026): BIT Jaipur internal round, nominated for the next round. Top 10, HackLoop (2025): Finalist from 1,600+ entrants, finale at Thoughtworks. 1st prize, IETE Student's Day (2025): Design competition, IETE Bhawan, Jaipur.
